mapper.select: -- 재전송은 만료/이후 정책 교체와 무관하게 원래 게시 영수증을 찾는다. SELECT id,policy_id,published_by,request_hash FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publications WHERE idempotency_key=#{key}
-- NOWAIT 전역 쓰기 경계. 외부 파일 추출/네트워크 실행을 이 잠금 안에서 수행하지 않는다. SELECT attachment_policy_publication_lock()::text
mapper.insert: -- 준비 scope와 QA를 다시 확인한 서비스만 호출한다. trigger가 현재성/전체 집합/소속도 검사한다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_policy_publications(id,scope_id,policy_id,policy_row_version,policy_hash, previous_policy_id,previous_policy_row_version,qa_run_id,evidence_hash,runtime_hash,published_by,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason_hash) SELECT #{publicationId},s.id,s.policy_id,s.policy_row_version+1,s.qa_snapshot_hash,p.id,p.row_version,s.qa_run_id, #{evidenceHash},#{runtimeHash},#{actorId},#{key},#{requestHash},#{reasonHash} FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes s LEFT JOIN announcement_attachment_policies p ON p.rule_release_id=s.rule_release_id AND p.policy_status_code='ACTIVE' WHERE s.id=#{scopeId} AND s.policy_id=#{policyId} AND s.requested_by=#{actorId}
mapper.update: -- 같은 규칙의 당시 ACTIVE 한 행만 퇴역한다. 기존 job/source binding은 보존한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_policies p SET policy_status_code='RETIRED',row_version=p.row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publications x WHERE x.id=#{publicationId} AND x.created_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND p.id=x.previous_policy_id AND p.policy_status_code='ACTIVE' AND p.row_version=x.previous_policy_row_version

-- 검증된 QA snapshot hash와 설치 runtime을 고정한다. 초안의 null runtime 필드만 해소하며 나머지 설정은 그대로다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_policies p SET policy_status_code='ACTIVE',policy_hash=x.policy_hash,published_at=x.published_at, settings_json=jsonb_set(p.settings_json,'{extractorConfigHash}',to_jsonb(x.runtime_hash),true), row_version=x.policy_row_version,updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publications x WHERE x.id=#{publicationId} AND x.created_xid=pg_current_xact_id() AND p.id=x.policy_id AND p.policy_status_code='DRAFT' AND p.row_version=x.policy_row_version-1
mapper.select: -- 정책마다 게시 영수증은 하나다. 이후 RETIRED 상태가 되어도 당시 게시 결과를 보존한다. SELECT x.id,x.policy_id,x.policy_row_version,x.policy_hash,x.previous_policy_id,x.previous_policy_row_version, x.scope_id,s.scope_hash,x.qa_run_id,s.mode_code,x.published_at FROM announcement_attachment_policy_publications x JOIN announcement_attachment_policy_publication_scopes s ON s.id=x.scope_id WHERE x.policy_id=#{policyId}
